title: feat(channels): wire Telegram channel into the chat server boot
body: ## Summary `@luna/channels` (the Telegram adapter, `ChannelService`, session-map, dedup, delivery) was fully implemented and unit-tested but was a **disconnected island** — nothing outside the package ever instantiated it. A repo-wide grep for `ChannelService` / `makeTelegramAdapter` / `@luna/channels` returned zero hits outside `packages/channels`, and no app depended on it. So the bot could never actually run. This PR wires it into the real server (`apps/ui-web/scripts/chat-server.ts`). No new feature flag — the presence of `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` is the only switch. What changed: - **`apps/ui-web/package.json`** — add `"@luna/channels": "workspace:*"`. - **`buildBaseLayer`** — build the two durable stores + the service and merge `ChannelService` into the runtime context. `ChannelServiceLayer` is provided the *same* `chatL` by reference, so it shares the one `ChatService` instance the WS server uses (Effect memoizes layers by reference — identical to the existing `chatThreadPosterL` pattern). `LunaSqliteBootstrap` is satisfied at the bottom of `buildServerLayer`, same as every other SQLite layer. ```ts const channelSessionStoreL = ChannelSessionStore.makeLayer(paths.lunaDbPath).pipe(Layer.provide(clockL)) const channelDedupStoreL = InboundDedupStore.makeLayer(paths.lunaDbPath).pipe(Layer.provide(clockL)) const channelServiceL = ChannelServiceLayer.pipe( Layer.provide(Layer.mergeAll(channelSessionStoreL, channelDedupStoreL, chatL, clockL)), ) return Layer.mergeAll(/* …existing… */, channelServiceL) ``` - **`buildMain`** — once the runtime is live, register + start the Telegram adapter when a token is set: ```ts const channels = yield* ChannelService const tgToken = process.env["TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN"]?.trim() if (tgToken) { yield* channels.registerAdapter(makeTelegramAdapter({ id: "telegram-main", token: Redacted.make(tgToken) })) yield* channels.startAdapters().pipe(Effect.scoped) // forks into the service's long-lived scope } // else: log "idle — set TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN to enable" ``` The token is held as `Redacted` so it never lands in logs/traces. `startAdapters()` forks adapters into the `ChannelService` scope (lives for the server's lifetime); the trailing `Effect.scoped` only discharges the unused ambient `Scope` on the API signature. - **`.env.example`** — document `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`. Result: inbound Telegram message → dedup → per-chat Luna thread (`lookupOrCreate`) → `chat.send` → a delivery fiber streams the agent reply back via Telegram `sendMessage`/`editMessageText`. ## Bug fix: dedup silently dropped every message under bun:sqlite Devin Review caught a real bug on the exact path this PR wires up. `InboundDedupStore.seenBefore` checked row existence with `!== undefined`, but **bun:sqlite's prepared-statement `.get()` returns `null` (not `undefined`)** when no row matches. So `null !== undefined` was `true` for *every* lookup → every inbound message was reported as already-seen → the channel dropped **all** traffic. The bug was invisible to the existing suite because those tests use the in-memory `InboundDedupStore.Memory` variant. ```diff - Effect.sync(() => seenStmt.get(transport, platformMessageId) !== undefined), + Effect.sync(() => seenStmt.get(transport, platformMessageId) != null), ``` Added a bun:sqlite-backed regression suite (`packages/channels/test/dedup-sqlite.test.ts`) that exercises the real SQLite layer — the first test asserts an unseen message reports `false` (fails against the old `!== undefined`). Because vitest can't load `bun:sqlite`, it's registered with the Bun test runner: added to `BUN_RUNTIME_TESTS` in `vitest.config.ts` (excluded from vitest) and to the `test:bun` script. ## Testing - `bunx vitest run packages/channels` — 33 pass (sqlite suite skipped under vitest, as designed). - `bun test packages/channels/test/dedup-sqlite.test.ts` — 3 pass; verified all 3 fail when reverting the fix to `!== undefined`. - `UI_WS_TOKEN=… bunx vitest run` over the chat-server-importing suites (`rename-chat-server`, `worker-registry-wiring`, `scheduler-v2-only`) — pass. - `bun run --filter '@luna/channels' typecheck` and `bun run --filter '@luna/ui-web' typecheck` — clean. - Diffed the improvised `tsc` baseline over `scripts/chat-server.ts` (the repo doesn't typecheck `scripts/` in CI): 27 errors before and 27 after — **zero new type errors**. ## Notes / follow-ups (not in this PR) - Long-poll only (no webhook mode); single bot instance (`telegram-main`); dedup table has no pruner (documented v1 behavior in `dedup.ts`). - `packages/core/src/gateway/` (`GatewayService`) is a second, still-dormant routing abstraction that duplicates the channels concept. Left untouched — worth a follow-up decision to consolidate or remove. - No boot smoke test covering the wired channel path yet. Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/7da0210065f64a59820c7af3d3c6fbff Requested by: @fourcolors ---
